svg.title: One question's history
svg.desc: The history of the question 'What was my personal best time in the charity 5K run?' as a row of 40 sessions from 23 April to 30 May 2023: most are simulated chats about the same user's other topics, some are public chats from ShareGPT and UltraChat, and two are the evidence sessions. On 23 May the user mentions a personal best of 27:12 while asking about soccer; on 30 May, asking about endurance training, they say they hope to beat their personal best of 25:50. The question is asked on 25 June, and the answer is 25:50. A second row shows the trimmed history used in the main run: the two evidence sessions and eight others drawn at random, in date order.
svg.text: “What was my personal best time in the charity 5K run?” The history holds 40 sessions. Two carry the evidence, and the
change is said in passing, inside a question about something else.
simulated chat with the same user, about other things
“I recently set a personal best time in a charity 5K run
with a time of 27:12. Do you have any tips on how to
improve my running technique […] on the soccer
“I'm training for another charity 5K run […] By the way,
I'm hoping to beat my personal best time of 25:50 this
The whole history, as LongMemEval's S version has it: 40 sessions, about 108,000 tokens. The full-history run used it.
The trimmed history of the main run: the 2 evidence sessions and 8 others drawn at random, in date order, about 28,000 tokens.
“What was my personal best time in the charity 5K run?”
